title: Completion of a quotient of a Noetherian local ring
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring, $\lambda:A\to B$ a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings with kernel $J$, and $\mathfrak n=\lambda(\mathfrak m)$, an ideal of $B$. Let $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_nA/\mathfrak m^n$ be the $\mathfrak m$-adic completion of $A$ and $B^\wedge=\varprojlim_nB/\mathfrak n^n$ the $\mathfrak n$-adic completion of $B$, with canonical maps $c_A:A\to A^\wedge$ and $c_B:B\to B^\wedge$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Since $\lambda(\mathfrak m^n)=\mathfrak n^n$, $\lambda$ induces surjections $A/\mathfrak m^n\to B/\mathfrak n^n$ and hence a ring map $\theta:A^\wedge\to B^\wedge$, $(x_n)_n\mapsto(\lambda(x_n))_n$, with $\theta\circ c_A=c_B\circ\lambda$. Then $\theta$ is surjective and its kernel is $JA^\wedge$, the ideal of $A^\wedge$ generated by $c_A(J)$; hence $\theta$ induces a ring isomorphism $A^\wedge/JA^\wedge\xrightarrow{\sim}B^\wedge$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00MA (lemma-completion-tensor, line 22901), parts (2) and (3), applied to the exact sequence of finite A-modules 0 -> J -> A -> B -> 0 and the ideal m (completion exact; B^ = B (x)_A A^ = A^/JA^), together with the observation that for the A-module B one has m^n B = n^n, so the m-adic completion of the A-module B is the n-adic completion of the ring B; used (with B = A/J) in the proof of More on Algebra Lemma Tag 07PP via Algebra Lemma Tag 07NC (lemma-completion-at-quasi-finite-prime).

proof.text: Construct q_k with Ideal.quotientMap using Ideal.map_pow. Check transition compatibility on representatives; check factorPow applied to completion evaluations using Cauchy representatives. Apply AdicCompletion.liftRingHom to q_k composed with evalₐ to construct θ. Its evaluation formula proves the coordinate squares and θ c_A = c_B φ. Each q_k is surjective by Ideal.quotientMap_surjective.

proof.text: Give B its A-algebra structure via φ. Ideal.smul_top_eq_map and Ideal.map_pow identify m^k times B with the restriction of n^k. Thus a ring-adic Cauchy sequence in B is also an m-adic A-module Cauchy sequence. AdicCompletion.map_surjective applied to the surjective linear map A -> B gives a completed preimage. Represent that preimage by a Cauchy sequence in A and compare quotient coordinates to prove θ is surjective.

proof.text: Set J = ker φ. Apply AdicCompletion.map_exact to the inclusion J -> A and quotient A -> A/J. These modules all have the universe of A, avoiding the universe restriction of map_exact when B has a different universe. For x in ker θ, represent x by a Cauchy sequence s. Its k-th image φ(s_k) lies in n^k = map φ (m^k); choose a_k in m^k with φ(a_k)=φ(s_k). Then s_k-a_k lies in J, so the class of s_k in A/J lies in m^k(A/J). Every coordinate of the completed quotient image of x is therefore zero. Exactness gives x as the completed image of some y in the completion of J.

proof.text: Noetherianity makes J finite. By AdicCompletion.ofTensorProduct_surjective_of_finite, write y as the image of a tensor t in Ahat tensor_A J. Tensor induction, ofTensorProduct_tmul, linearity of the completed inclusion, and map_of show its image lies in J.map c_A: zero lies there, a pure tensor maps to a*c_A(j), and addition preserves membership. Conversely θ c_A = c_B φ kills J, so Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap gives J.map c_A contained in ker θ. This proves kernel equality.

lean.statement: theorem exists_local_completion_quotient (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) : let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A let n := m.map φ let Ahat := AdicCompletion m A let Bhat := AdicCompletion n B let cA := algebraMap A Ahat let cB := algebraMap B Bhat let Jhat := (RingHom.ker φ).map cA (∀ k : ℕ, (m ^ k).map φ = n ^ k) ∧ ∃ θ : Ahat →+* Bhat, (∀ k : ℕ, ∃ θk : (A ⧸ m ^ k) →+* (B ⧸ n ^ k), Function.Surjective θk ∧ θk.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (m ^ k)) = (Ideal.Quotient.mk (n ^ k)).comp φ ∧ (evalₐ n k).toRingHom.comp θ = θk.comp (evalₐ m k).toRingHom) ∧ θ.comp cA = cB.comp φ ∧ Function.Surjective θ ∧ RingHom.ker θ = Jhat ∧ ∃ e : (Ahat ⧸ Jhat) ≃+* Bhat, ∀ x : Ahat, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk Jhat x) = θ x

reviewed_lean.note: A,B CommRing u/v; Noetherian local A only; φ surjective, J=ker φ derived; m maximalIdeal, n=m.map φ (=image by surjectivity); AdicCompletion m A / n B, cA,cB algebraMap; θ pinned coordinatewise via θk (mk-compatible, surjective) and evalₐ squares, so unique; θ∘cA=cB∘φ, surjective, ker θ = J.map cA, e : Ahat⧸Jhat ≃+* Bhat induced by θ; not in Mathlib (kerProj/ker_evalOneₐ_eq_map only special cases)
